summary: Decrypts the *message* parameter using the **private** key
description:
The .decrypt() function decrypts the message parameter using the private key. The algorithm used depends on the type of the key.

The key must be a RSA key, the algorithm is RSA-OAEP (see RFC 3447).

params.name: message
params.description: Message string to be decoded using `options.encodingEncrypted` and decrypted.

success.description: True if the message has been successfully decrypted

result.description: Message decrypted and decoded using the options.encodingDecrypted

errors.description: If success is false, may contain a collection of errors

errorModel.note: failure is reported in the returned status object, not by throwing
